scope.rootUnion: A species is selected once when any declared COL root occurs in its lineage; nested roots are not additive.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Chondrichthyes species.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact nomenclatural crosswalk. It is not a final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier, fossil record or expert-review record.

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search non-overlapping inclusive COL usage-ID ranges; one detail request loads one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No COL usage ID is assigned; the complete ITIS-only current-species partition is a separate immutable JSONL gzip shard when non-empty.
